articles.summary: ATLANTA, May 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Acuity Inc. (NYSE: AYI) (the “Company”) will release fiscal 2026 third-quarter results on Thursday, June 25, 2026 at 6:00 a.m. ET, followed by a conference call at 8:00 a.m. ET. Neil Ashe, Chief Executive Officer of Acuity Inc., will lead the call.
articles.title: Acuity to Announce Fiscal 2026 Third-Quarter Results on June 25, 2026
